title: Model-level cooldowns preserving sibling models, retry budgets, runtime strategy switch, cooldown reset endpoint

type.name: Feature
type.description: A request, idea, or new functionality

body:
Part of #720 (sub-issue). Case study: [docs/case-studies/issue-720](https://github.com/link-assistant/router/blob/issue-720-99e7abc4e6c1/docs/case-studies/issue-720/README.md).

## Summary
Router cools down the whole account on a quota error. CLIProxyAPI cools the `(credential, model)` pair and keeps sibling models available (`TestCodexModelLevelCoolingPreservesSiblingModel`), while a terminal quota error still cools the account (`TestCodexTerminalQuotaCoolsAccountAcrossModels`). CLIProxyAPI also has retry rounds with a credential cap and interval cap, a runtime strategy switch, a cooldown reset endpoint and subagent session-affinity inheritance. For mixed-model Codex and Claude pools this is a correctness gap.

Case study: `docs/case-studies/issue-720/solution-plans.md` § I.

## Proposal
1. Cooldown state keyed by `(account, model)` with an account-wide entry for terminal quota errors and auth failures; the existing `ACCOUNT_PAUSE_AT_PERCENT` and vendor window state stay account-wide.
2. `POOL_RETRY_ROUNDS` (default 0 = current behaviour), `POOL_MAX_RETRY_CREDENTIALS` (0 = all), `POOL_MAX_RETRY_INTERVAL_SECS` alongside `POOL_FAILOVER_*`; failover remains pre-first-byte only (#676).
3. `PATCH /api/management/routing` to switch `ACCOUNT_ROUTING_STRATEGY` at runtime; `POST /api/management/routing/cooldown/reset` for all, one account, or one `(account, model)`; both audit-logged.
4. `SESSION_AFFINITY_SUBAGENTS` (default `true`): child sessions bind to the parent's account.
5. Keep upstream timeouts as decided in #669.

## Tests
Port both quota-failover tests and the four stream-disconnect failover tests from CLIProxyAPI `test/` to Router's recorded-fixture harness with a controllable clock. Property test: cooldown never exceeds the configured maximum. Runtime strategy switch takes effect on the next new session only.

## Prior art
CLIProxyAPI `test/codex_quota_failover_test.go`, `test/codex_stream_disconnect_failover_test.go`, `internal/runtime/executor/*ratelimit*_test.go`; Router #676, #677.

## Compatibility
Default retry rounds are 0, so behaviour is unchanged unless configured. Model-level cooling is strictly less restrictive than today.
